summary: Execution nodes go in [execution_nodes], with defaults receptor_port=27199, receptor_protocol=tcp, receptor_type=execution (or hop); they peer with all controllers unless receptor_peers lists host names.
questions: How do I add execution nodes to containerized AAP?
What is the default receptor port?
Can I use group names in receptor_peers?

answer_card.title: Containerized execution nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[execution_nodes]
exec1.example.org
hop1.example.org receptor_type=hop
```
Defaults: `receptor_port=27199`, `receptor_protocol=tcp`, `receptor_type=execution`.
`receptor_peers` is a comma-separated list of **host names**, not group names.
